<a id="nestedatt--items--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.spec`

Read-Only:

- `address_families` (List of String) Address families to enable. Uses a single-topology (native) configuration mode.
- `area_ids` (List of String) The list of IS-IS area addresses for this instance. Each area address is represented as an NSAP Area ID, which is a string in the format of AFI.area-address (e.g. '49.0001'). The system ID and NSEL are not included in the area address as they are derived from the router's configuration and do not need to be specified by the user.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables IS-IS instance.
- `hello_padding` (String) Hello Padding mode for IS-IS adjacencies.
- `level1` (Attributes) IS-IS Level 1 settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--level1))
- `level2` (Attributes) IS-IS Level 2 settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--level2))
- `level_capability` (String) IS-IS level capability for this instance.
- `lfa` (Attributes) LFA (Loop-Free Alternate) functionality. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--lfa))
- `lsp_mtu` (Number) Maximum LSP MTU size, in bytes.
- `max_ecmp` (Number) The maximum number of ECMP paths (next-hops).
- `overload` (Attributes) IS-IS Overload configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--overload))
- `passive_only` (Boolean) Advertise prefixes that belong to passive interfaces only.
- `redistribution` (Attributes) Route redistribution settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--redistribution))
- `reference_bandwidth_gbps` (Number) Reference bandwidth (in Gbps) for automatic metric calculation.
- `segment_routing` (Attributes) Segment Routing settings for the IS-IS instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--segment_routing))
- `timers` (Attributes) Configures IS-IS timers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--timers))
- `tlv_config` (Attributes) IS-IS (optional) TLV configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--spec--tlv_config))
